mechanism: Amoxicillin-clavulanate disrupts gut flora that produce vitamin K, reducing warfarin metabolism competition and increasing INR; additionally, amoxicillin may displace warfarin from protein binding.
action: Monitor INR closely during and for 2-3 weeks after amoxicillin-clavulanate therapy; consider warfarin dose reduction or use alternative antibiotic if possible; educate patient on bleeding signs.
